<style id="ww-article-style">

/* ===== CSS 变量（仅文章页作用域） ===== */
body{
--ww-ink:#0a0e1a !important;
--ww-brand:#1d4ed8 !important;
--ww-brand-2:#1e4ca8 !important;
--ww-brand-glow:rgba(30,76,168,.12) !important;
--ww-accent:#d9480f !important;
--ww-text:#0a0e1a !important;
--ww-text-2:#5a6577 !important;
--ww-text-3:#9aa4b8 !important;
--ww-bg:#fafbfd !important;
--ww-bg-card:#ffffff !important;
--ww-bg-soft:#f4f6fa !important;
--ww-border:#ebedf3 !important;
--ww-border-soft:#f0f2f7 !important;
--ww-radius:12px !important;
--ww-radius-lg:18px !important;
--ww-radius-xl:24px !important;
--ww-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(10,14,26,.06) !important;
--ww-shadow-lg:0 24px 64px rgba(10,14,26,.08) !important;
}

/* ============================================================
1. 隐藏原站顶部横幅 + Banner（.hengfu / .ny_ban）
改造为深色渐变 Banner
============================================================ */
body .hengfu{display:none !important}

body .ny_ban{
position:relative !important;
min-height:380px !important;
padding:0 !important;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0a0e1a 0%,#141a2e 50%,#0a0e1a 100%) !important;
background-image:none !important;
overflow:hidden !important;
border-radius:0 !important;
}
body .ny_ban::before{
content:"" !important;
position:absolute !important;
inset:0 !important;
background:radial-gradient(circle at 25% 30%,rgba(30,76,168,.45),transparent 55%),
radial-gradient(circle at 85% 75%,rgba(217,72,15,.18),transparent 48%) !important;
pointer-events:none !important;
}
body .ny_ban::after{
content:"" !important;
position:absolute !important;
inset:0 !important;
background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px),
linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,transparent 1px) !important;
background-size:48px 48px !important;
pointer-events:none !important;
}
body .ny_ban .container{
position:relative !important;
z-index:2 !important;
max-width:1180px !important;
padding:64px 32px !important;
}
body .ny_ban .w_z h3{
font-size:clamp(28px,3.8vw,46px) !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
color:#fff !important;
letter-spacing:-.028em !important;
line-height:1.22 !important;
margin-bottom:24px !important;
text-shadow:none !important;
animation:none !important;
}
body .ny_ban .w_z h4{
font-size:16px !important;
color:rgba(255,255,255,.6) !important;
line-height:1.95 !important;
font-weight:400 !important;
letter-spacing:.04em !important;
text-transform:none !important;
animation:none !important;
}

/* ============================================================
2. 子栏目导航（.ny_lm1）简化
============================================================ */
body .ny_lm1{
background:var(--ww-bg-card) !important;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
padding:18px 0 !important;
}
body .ny_lm1 .container{max-width:1180px !important}
body .ny_lm1 ul{
display:flex !important;
gap:8px !important;
list-style:none !important;
margin:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
body .ny_lm1 li{margin:0 !important;padding:0 !important;list-style:none !important}
body .ny_lm1 li a{
display:inline-block !important;
padding:8px 18px !important;
font-size:13px !important;
font-weight:500 !important;
color:var(--ww-text-2) !important;
background:var(--ww-bg-soft) !important;
border:1px solid var(--ww-border) !important;
border-radius:100px !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
transition:all .3s !important;
}
body .ny_lm1 li a:hover,
body .ny_lm1 li a.active{
background:var(--ww-brand) !important;
border-color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
color:#fff !important;
}

/* ============================================================
3. 文章主体容器（.gs_js / .gs_wz / .m_content）
============================================================ */
body .gs_js{
padding:72px 0 80px !important;
margin-top: 50px;
}
body .gs_js .container{max-width:1180px !important}
body .gs_js .gs_wz{
background:transparent !important;
padding:0 !important;
margin:0 !important;
border:0 !important;
box-shadow:none !important;
}
body .gs_js .m_content{
background:transparent !important;
padding:0 !important;
margin:0 !important;
border:0 !important;
box-shadow:none !important;
}
/* 隐藏原站可能有的空 spacer */
body .gs_js .blank10{display:none !important}

/* ============================================================
4. 文章标题（.m_content h2）
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .m_content > h2{
font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,44px) !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
letter-spacing:-.028em !important;
line-height:1.25 !important;
margin:0 0 24px !important;
padding:0 !important;
text-align:left !important;
background:transparent !important;
border:0 !important;
}

/* ============================================================
5. 文章元信息（.info）
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .m_content > .info{
display:flex !important;
align-items:center !important;
gap:14px !important;
flex-wrap:wrap !important;
font-size:13px !important;
color:var(--ww-text-3) !important;
letter-spacing:.04em !important;
margin:0 0 36px !important;
padding:0 0 24px !important;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
background:transparent !important;
}

/* ============================================================
6. ★ 通用 CMS 富文本样式（.page_content 内所有标签自动美化）
这是核心部分：无论 CMS 输出什么 HTML，都自动套用统一样式
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .page_content{
max-width:760px !important;
margin:0 auto !important;
padding:0 !important;
font-family:"PingFang SC","HarmonyOS Sans SC","Microsoft YaHei",system-ui,sans-serif !important;
font-size:15.5px !important;
line-height:2.05 !important;
color:#2a3346 !important;
}

/* 段落 */
body .gs_js .page_content p{
font-size:15.5px !important;
line-height:2.05 !important;
color:#2a3346 !important;
margin:0 0 28px !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
/* 首段首字下沉（可选） */
body .gs_js .page_content > p:first-of-type::first-letter{
float:left !important;
font-size:56px !important;
line-height:.9 !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
margin:8px 14px 0 0 !important;
}

/* 标题 H1-H6 */
body .gs_js .page_content h1,
body .gs_js .page_content h2,
body .gs_js .page_content h3,
body .gs_js .page_content h4,
body .gs_js .page_content h5,
body .gs_js .page_content h6{
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
letter-spacing:-.02em !important;
line-height:1.4 !important;
margin:56px 0 22px !important;
padding:0 !important;
background:transparent !important;
border:0 !important;
text-align:left !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content h1{font-size:30px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h2{font-size:24px !important;margin:64px 0 26px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h3{font-size:19px !important;font-weight:700 !important;margin:44px 0 18px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h4{font-size:16.5px !important;margin:32px 0 14px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h5{font-size:15px !important;color:var(--ww-text-2) !important;margin:28px 0 12px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h6{font-size:13.5px !important;color:var(--ww-text-2) !important;text-transform:uppercase !important;letter-spacing:.08em !important;margin:24px 0 10px !important}

/* 强调 */
body .gs_js .page_content strong,
body .gs_js .page_content b{color:var(--ww-ink) !important;font-weight:700 !important}
body .gs_js .page_content em,
body .gs_js .page_content i{font-style:italic !important;color:#2a3346 !important}
body .gs_js .page_content mark{background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 60%,rgba(217,72,15,.18) 60%) !important;color:var(--ww-ink) !important;padding:0 2px !important}

/* 列表 */
body .gs_js .page_content ul,
body .gs_js .page_content ol{
margin:0 0 28px !important;
padding-left:0 !important;
list-style:none !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content li{
position:relative !important;
padding-left:26px !important;
margin-bottom:12px !important;
font-size:15px !important;
line-height:1.95 !important;
color:#2a3346 !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content ul li::before{
content:"" !important;
position:absolute !important;
left:4px !important;
top:13px !important;
width:6px !important;
height:6px !important;
border-radius:2px !important;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--ww-brand),var(--ww-brand-2)) !important;
transform:rotate(45deg) !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content ol{counter-reset:ww-ol !important}
body .gs_js .page_content ol li{counter-increment:ww-ol !important;padding-left:34px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content ol li::before{
content:counter(ww-ol,decimal-leading-zero) !important;
position:absolute !important;
left:0 !important;
top:2px !important;
font-size:12.5px !important;
font-weight:700 !important;
color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
background:transparent !important;
width:auto !important;
height:auto !important;
border-radius:0 !important;
transform:none !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content li strong{color:var(--ww-ink) !important}

/* 链接 */
body .gs_js .page_content a{
color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--ww-brand-glow) !important;
transition:border-color .3s,background .3s !important;
padding:0 1px !important;
border-radius:2px !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content a:hover{
border-color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
background:rgba(29,78,216,.06) !important;
}

/* 引用块 */
body .gs_js .page_content blockquote{
position:relative !important;
margin:40px 0 !important;
padding:28px 32px !important;
background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(21,56,122,.045),rgba(30,76,168,.02)) !important;
border-left:3px solid var(--ww-brand) !important;
border-right:0 !important;
border-top:0 !important;
border-bottom:0 !important;
border-radius:0 var(--ww-radius) var(--ww-radius) 0 !important;
font-size:16.5px !important;
line-height:1.9 !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
font-weight:600 !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content blockquote p{
font-size:inherit !important;
line-height:inherit !important;
color:inherit !important;
font-weight:inherit !important;
margin:0 !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content blockquote cite{
display:block !important;
font-size:12.5px !important;
color:var(--ww-text-3) !important;
margin-top:14px !important;
font-weight:400 !important;
font-style:normal !important;
}

/* 行内代码 + 代码块 */
body .gs_js .page_content code{
font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",Menlo,monospace !important;
font-size:.88em !important;
color:var(--ww-brand-2) !important;
background:rgba(21,56,122,.06) !important;
padding:2px 7px !important;
border-radius:5px !important;
font-weight:500 !important;
word-break:break-word !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content pre{
margin:36px 0 !important;
padding:24px 26px !important;
background:#0a0e1a !important;
color:rgba(255,255,255,.88) !important;
border-radius:var(--ww-radius) !important;
border:0 !important;
overflow-x:auto !important;
line-height:1.7 !important;
font-size:13.5px !important;
font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,"Liberation Mono",Menlo,monospace !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content pre code{
background:transparent !important;
color:inherit !important;
padding:0 !important;
font-size:inherit !important;
font-weight:400 !important;
}

/* 分割线 */
body .gs_js .page_content hr{
border:0 !important;
height:1px !important;
background:var(--ww-border) !important;
margin:48px 0 !important;
position:relative !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content hr::before{
content:"" !important;
position:absolute !important;
left:50% !important;
top:50% !important;
transform:translate(-50%,-50%) !important;
width:8px !important;
height:8px !important;
border-radius:50% !important;
background:var(--ww-brand) !important;
}

/* 图片 */
body .gs_js .page_content img{
display:block !important;
max-width:100% !important;
height:auto !important;
border-radius:var(--ww-radius) !important;
margin:32px auto !important;
box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(10,14,26,.04) !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content figure{
margin:40px 0 !important;
text-align:center !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content figure img{margin:0 auto !important}
body .gs_js .page_content figcaption{
font-size:12px !important;
color:var(--ww-text-3) !important;
text-align:center !important;
margin-top:14px !important;
letter-spacing:.05em !important;
}

/* 表格 */
body .gs_js .page_content table{
width:100% !important;
border-collapse:separate !important;
border-spacing:0 !important;
margin:36px 0 !important;
font-size:14px !important;
border:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
border-radius:var(--ww-radius) !important;
overflow:hidden !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content th,
body .gs_js .page_content td{
padding:14px 18px !important;
text-align:left !important;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
line-height:1.7 !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content th{
background:var(--ww-bg-soft) !important;
font-weight:700 !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
font-size:13px !important;
}
body .gs_js .page_content tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none !important}
body .gs_js .page_content tr:nth-child(even) td{background:rgba(244,246,250,.5) !important}

/* 定义列表 */
body .gs_js .page_content dl{margin:0 0 28px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content dt{font-weight:700 !important;color:var(--ww-ink) !important;margin-bottom:6px !important;font-size:15px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content dd{margin:0 0 16px 26px !important;font-size:15px !important;line-height:1.95 !important;color:#2a3346 !important}

/* 键盘按键 */
body .gs_js .page_content kbd{
display:inline-block !important;
padding:2px 8px !important;
font-size:12px !important;
font-family:inherit !important;
background:var(--ww-bg-soft) !important;
border:1px solid var(--ww-border) !important;
border-bottom-width:2px !important;
border-radius:5px !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
font-weight:600 !important;
}

/* ============================================================
7. 标签区（.xypg-detail-tags）
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .xypg-detail-tags{
max-width:760px !important;
margin:48px auto 0 !important;
padding:28px 0 0 !important;
border-top:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
background:transparent !important;
display:flex !important;
align-items:center !important;
gap:14px !important;
flex-wrap:wrap !important;
}
body .gs_js .xypg-detail-tags .tags-title h3{
font-size:13px !important;
font-weight:700 !important;
color:var(--ww-text-3) !important;
letter-spacing:.08em !important;
text-transform:uppercase !important;
margin:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
body .gs_js .xypg-detail-tags .tags-content{
display:flex !important;
gap:8px !important;
flex-wrap:wrap !important;
}
body .gs_js .xypg-detail-tags .tags-content a{
display:inline-block !important;
font-size:12px !important;
color:var(--ww-text-2) !important;
padding:7px 14px !important;
background:var(--ww-bg-soft) !important;
border:1px solid var(--ww-border) !important;
border-radius:100px !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
transition:all .3s !important;
font-weight:500 !important;
}
body .gs_js .xypg-detail-tags .tags-content a:hover{
background:var(--ww-brand) !important;
border-color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
color:#fff !important;
transform:translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ============================================================
8. 上一篇 / 下一篇（.prevpage）→ 双列卡片
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .prevpage{
max-width:760px !important;
margin:36px auto 0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
display:grid !important;
grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr !important;
gap:18px !important;
background:transparent !important;
border:0 !important;
}
body .gs_js .prevpage p{
margin:0 !important;
padding:22px 24px !important;
background:var(--ww-bg-soft) !important;
border:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
border-radius:var(--ww-radius) !important;
font-size:13px !important;
color:var(--ww-text-3) !important;
line-height:1.6 !important;
transition:all .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) !important;
display:flex !important;
flex-direction:column !important;
gap:8px !important;
}
body .gs_js .prevpage p:hover{
transform:translateY(-3px) !important;
background:var(--ww-bg-card) !important;
box-shadow:0 18px 40px -18px rgba(10,14,26,.12) !important;
border-color:transparent !important;
}
body .gs_js .prevpage p a{
font-size:14.5px !important;
font-weight:700 !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
border:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
line-height:1.55 !important;
transition:color .3s !important;
}
body .gs_js .prevpage p:hover a{color:var(--ww-brand) !important}
/* 第二个 p（下一篇）右对齐 */
body .gs_js .prevpage p:nth-child(2){
text-align:right !important;
align-items:flex-end !important;
}

/* ============================================================
9. 阅读进度条（可选，如果页面包含 #progress 元素）
============================================================ */
body #progress{
position:fixed !important;
top:0 !important;
left:0 !important;
right:0 !important;
height:3px !important;
z-index:99998 !important;
background:transparent !important;
pointer-events:none !important;
}
body #progress .bar{
height:100% !important;
width:0 !important;
background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ww-brand),var(--ww-brand-2) 70%,var(--ww-accent)) !important;
border-radius:0 3px 3px 0 !important;
transition:width .1s linear !important;
}

/* ============================================================
10. 响应式
============================================================ */
@media(max-width:991px){
body .gs_js .page_content{padding:0 20px !important}
body .gs_js .m_content > h2{font-size:26px !important}
body .ny_ban{min-height:300px !important}
body .ny_ban .container{padding:48px 24px !important}
body .gs_js .prevpage{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;gap:12px !important}
body .gs_js .prevpage p:nth-child(2){text-align:left !important;align-items:flex-start !important}
}
@media(max-width:560px){
body .gs_js .page_content{font-size:15px !important;padding:0 16px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content p{font-size:15px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content h2{font-size:21px !important;margin:48px 0 22px !important}
body .gs_js .page_content blockquote{padding:22px 22px !important}
body .ny_ban .container{padding:36px 20px !important}
body .gs_js .m_content > h2{font-size:22px !important}
body .gs_js .prevpage p{padding:18px 18px !important}
}

/* ============================================================
11. ★ 双列布局：.gs_wz 变成 grid（左正文 + 右侧栏 sticky）
============================================================ */
body .gs_js .gs_wz{
display:grid !important;
grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 320px !important;
gap:48px !important;
align-items:start !important;
max-width:1180px !important;
margin:0 auto !important;
padding:0 32px !important;
}
body .gs_js .gs_wz > .m_content{
min-width:0 !important;
max-width:none !important;
margin:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
body .gs_js .gs_wz > .article-sidebar{
position:relative !important;
min-width:0 !important;
margin:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
body .gs_js .gs_wz > .article-sidebar > .sidebar-sticky{
position:sticky !important;
top:96px !important;
}

/* ============================================================
12. 侧栏标题（.sidebar-head）
============================================================ */
body .sidebar-head{
margin-bottom:24px !important;
padding-bottom:20px !important;
border-bottom:1px solid var(--ww-border-soft) !important;
}
body .sidebar-head .sec-eyebrow{
font-size:11.5px !important;
font-weight:600 !important;
color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
letter-spacing:.18em !important;
text-transform:uppercase !important;
margin-bottom:10px !important;
display:flex !important;
align-items:center !important;
gap:12px !important;
}
body .sidebar-head .sec-eyebrow .dot{
width:6px !important;
height:6px !important;
border-radius:50% !important;
background:var(--ww-brand) !important;
display:inline-block !important;
}
body .sidebar-head h3{
font-size:18px !important;
font-weight:800 !important;
color:var(--ww-ink) !important;
letter-spacing:-.02em !important;
line-height:1.35 !important;
margin:0 !important;
padding:0 !important;
}
body .sidebar-head h3 .em{color:var(--ww-brand) !important}
body .sidebar-more{
display:inline-flex !important;
align-items:center !important;
gap:6px !important;
font-size:12.5px !important;
font-weight:600 !important;
color:var(--ww-brand) !important;
margin-top:12px !important;
text-decoration:none !important;
transition:gap .3s !important;
}
body .sidebar-more svg{width:14px !important;height:14px !important}
body .sidebar-more:hover{gap:10px !important}

/* ============================================================
13. 案例推荐紧凑卡（.case-side-card）
============================================================ */
body .case-side-card{

class="page_content"><p>近日，广州信朴科技有限公司宣布，其为华南安全防护用品领军企业——广东金亿防护定制的企业级AI智能体（Agent）项目成功落地并取得显著成效。经过8个月的深度合作，信朴科技为金亿防护搭建的售前智能接待Agent运行稳定，客户咨询响应时效缩短70%，人工客服接待量占比下降65%，大幅提升了企业的客户服务能力与运营效率。</p><p>广东金亿防护是华南地区劳保行业的标杆企业，产品线涵盖安全帽、防护服、防护手套等多个品类。随着业务规模扩大，企业每天接收大量客户咨询，售前接待压力持续增加。传统的人工客服模式面临响应慢、人力成本高、高峰期服务能力不足等问题，亟需通过AI技术实现售前接待的智能化升级。</p><p>针对金亿防护的业务特点，信朴科技组建专项技术团队，深入调研其客户咨询场景、产品知识体系和业务流程，为其量身定制了专属的售前智能接待Agent。该Agent具备以下核心能力：</p><p><strong>一、智能问答</strong>：基于金亿防护全品类产品知识库，Agent能够准确回答客户关于产品规格、适用场景、价格等常见咨询，实现7×24小时自动响应。</p><p><strong>二、需求引导</strong>：Agent能够通过多轮对话理解客户的实际防护需求，主动推荐合适的产品方案，提升客户体验和转化率。</p><p><strong>三、智能分流</strong>：对于复杂咨询或高价值客户，Agent能够自动识别并转接人工客服，确保关键客户得到专业服务。</p><p>项目上线运行后，效果立竿见影。客户咨询响应时效从原来的平均数分钟缩短至秒级响应，缩短幅度达70%；人工客服接待量占比下降65%，释放出的客服人力可专注于高价值客户的深度服务和售后支持。</p><p>信朴科技技术负责人表示："企业级Agent定制的核心在于深入理解客户业务。我们不是简单地部署一个聊天机器人，而是从产品知识、业务流程、客户体验三个维度进行系统设计，确保Agent真正解决企业的业务痛点。金亿防护项目的成功，验证了我们在Agent定制领域的专业能力。"</p><p>广东金亿防护方面也对合作成果表示高度认可，认为信朴科技的Agent定制服务不仅降低了客服成本，更显著提升了客户满意度和品牌形象。</p><p><sc-clipboard
